trial_court: Family Court at Hyderabad, OP Nos. 775 of 1996 and 567 of 1995
case_name: K. Radha Raju vs K. Seetharama Raju
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 1993. The wife filed a petition for restitution of conjugal rights under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The husband filed a petition seeking dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court granted the husband's petition and dismissed the wife's petition.

legal_principles.principle: A person's safety and well-being are important considerations in a divorce petition.
legal_principles.held: In the circumstances, it is most unsafe for him to live in the society of the wife.
use_in: divorce cases where harassment is involved

legal_principles.principle: A person's freedom to file a petition for dissolution of marriage should not be curtailed by threats or coercion.
legal_principles.held: He was constrained to file Writ Petition No. 12746 of 1996 seeking a direction from this Court restraining police authorities from forcing him to withdraw OP No. 567 of 1995.
